In Black Cross, New Mexico, she contrasted the handmade cross, magnified in scale and isolated flat against the picture plane, with the distant brilliance of the sunset behind the rolling hills. | Title | Year | Medium | Subject/Location | Provenance / Collection status (as of June 2024) |

| **Red Hills with Flowers** | 1937 | Oil on canvas | Landscape of New Mexico (red hills, flowers) | Bequeathed to the Art Institute of Chicago in 1992; is part of the museum’s permanent collection. |

1. **Black Cross, New Mexico**
